Name: Central Station - Recolor Compatibility Patch
Author: crystalinerose
Description:
[center][size=3]A quick little recolor compatibility patch I made for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8000]Central Station[/url]﻿'s interior map, made to match Earthy, VPR, and Starblue interiors. Patchy interior border tiles begone! (Among other things!)[/size][/center]
[i][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Lx0ybss/config-options.png[/img][/i]

[list]
[*][b]Recolor Option: [/b]Toggle for which recolor the compatibility patch will be toggled to. Default [i]Off.[/i]
[/list][i]
[/i][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/3NC8PLn/compatibility.png[/img]

[b][u]Compatible[/u] [/b]with the following mods that affect interior recolors: [b]VPR, Earthy Interiors, Starblue Valley[/b].

﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/0sYpYjq/installation.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8000]Central Station[/url]﻿.
[*]Download and unzip [i]"[CP] Central Station Recolor" [/i]archive into your SteamLibrary/common/Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]﻿Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]Have fun!
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/JRHCTRD/bugs-issues.png[/img]

[list]
[*]No known issues for the time being.
[/list]
[size=3][b]Please prioritize reporting any bugs on the Nexus page and follow the directions listed in the pinned comment.[/b][/size]

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/VVn4qL0/credits.png[/img]

Thank you to Pathoschild for creating Central Station and providing easier recolor support for its custom assets. This has been a fun project to work on!

Thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/6480/mods]6480[/url] for the wonderful new assets, which are adorable and fun to recolor :))

A special thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Teaiscoldagain?gameId=1303]Lina[/url] and her recolor tool (Coming Soon™️). If you are a pixel artist who wants to recolor your stuff 10x faster and are interested to test/give feedback for the recolor tool, feel free to reach out to Lina (@teaiscoldagain) on Discord or in the [url=https://discord.gg/stardewvalley]Stardew Valley official server[/url]!

[size=3][center]🍊 Enjoy my works? You can follow me on [url=http://meadowlade.tumblr.com]my Tumblr[/url]﻿, or support me by buying a [url=https://ko-fi.com/crystalinerose]coffee[/url]﻿! :) 🍊[/center][/size]
